---
name: Diagram request (USD 30)
about: Ask for an editable SVG diagram of one technical procedure of yours
title: "Diagram request: <procedure name>"
labels: diagram-request
---

Please do not paste secrets, customer data or private URLs here. A short description is enough;
details can be shared privately once we agree on the scope.

**Procedure** (for example: "how our payment webhook is verified and applied", "how a refund is reconciled")

**Steps you already know** (a rough list is fine)

**Where the diagram will live** (README, internal wiki, onboarding doc, client handover)

**Language** (English, Spanish or both)

Scope and price: one procedure, up to about 9 boxes, delivered as an editable SVG plus a PNG,
one round of corrections, USD 30. I reply here first to confirm the scope before any work starts.
